research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Features
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by auditing missing values, standardizing feature encodings, and separating training and evaluation records under a predefined protocol.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines with imputation pipelines, documenting discrimination and calibration across prescribed missingness conditions.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Maintained Python routines for validating incoming tabular records, handling malformed fields, and generating structured error reports for downstream processing.
Added regression tests for parsing and transformation logic, investigated failed processing jobs, and documented expected behavior for recurring input exceptions.

projects.title: Regularized Linear Regression Baselines
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression baselines with standardized features and cross validation to select regularization settings on tabular prediction tasks.
Compared validation errors and coefficient patterns against ordinary least squares, documenting sensitivity to correlated predictors and alternative feature scaling choices.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Clustering Baselines
bullets: Implemented a baseline clustering workflow using Gaussian mixture models, comparing covariance parameterizations on synthetic datasets with overlapping component distributions.
Examined initialization sensitivity and information criteria across candidate models, documenting how distributional assumptions affected fitted clusters and assignment uncertainty.
